arcs.summary: Nithish arrives, joins Elmwood and begins to find his place.

arcs.title: Secrets Beneath the Surface
arcs.summary: Lessons settle into routine as small irregularities appear.

arcs.title: Friends and Rivals
arcs.summary: A house competition tests loyalty and confidence.

arcs.title: The Alchemy Project
arcs.summary: A group laboratory project teaches trust and patience.

arcs.summary: The academy prepares its annual festival.

arcs.summary: A research assignment leads to overlooked records.

arcs.title: Trials of Mastery
arcs.summary: Examinations test skill, judgment and resilience.

houses.name: Elmwood
houses.motto: Strength is gentleness that refuses to surrender.
houses.history: Founded by healers and patient teachers, Elmwood became a refuge for students who believed knowledge should protect the vulnerable. Its members value steady courage, loyalty and practical kindness.
houses.room: A warm common room overlooking an old courtyard tree, with plants, reading alcoves and a broad hearth.

houses.name: Embercrest
houses.history: Founded by explorers who led the academy's earliest expeditions, Embercrest prizes initiative and brave action. Its traditions teach that courage must be guided by responsibility.
houses.room: A bright upper hall with a practice balcony, trophy gallery and a long red-gold table.

houses.name: Starfall
houses.history: Born from astronomers and inventors, Starfall values curiosity and imagination. Its students keep unanswered questions as carefully as discoveries.
houses.room: A high observatory lounge with curved windows, star charts and quiet study desks.

houses.name: Thornkeep
houses.motto: What is worth doing is worth doing well.
houses.history: Established by guardians and craftspeople who maintained the academy through uncertain times, Thornkeep prizes preparation, patience and keeping one's word.
houses.room: A calm stone room beside the gardens, with a workshop corner, chess tables and a library ladder.

episodes.title: Day 001 · The Letter That Changed Everything
episodes.opening: Day 001 begins with the letter that changed everything. At the practice arena, Nithish spots a copper tuning fork. It is not a grand crisis; it is the sort of small, specific problem that can be ignored until it affects somebody. Because this part of the year is about new beginnings, he takes a moment to notice who is nearby, what has changed, and what the evidence actually says. The ordinary academy morning suddenly has a decision waiting inside it.
episodes.middle: By the next bell, during “The Letter That Changed Everything,” the situation has drawn in more than one point of view. Professor Vale gives the students time to solve the issue instead of stepping in immediately. Nithish has to balance belonging with the practical needs of the people involved. A quick answer would be easier, but the group needs a response that can be explained and shared. With a copper tuning fork still between them, they compare what they know, test one small idea, and discover that the best progress often begins with a good question.
episodes.closing: At the end of Day 001, after “The Letter That Changed Everything,” the detail that stays with Nithish is not the object itself but the way people responded. He can choose a direct approach that protects time and momentum, or a more patient approach that brings others into the decision. Either way, tomorrow will remember what he does today. The lesson is simple: small acts of courage. The lamps of Aurelion come on one by one, reflecting in a copper tuning fork as he makes up his mind.
